description: Class representing a small text block called 'run'.

AddColumnBreak.description: Adds a column break to the current run position and starts the next element from a new column.

AddComment.description:
Adds a comment to the current run.

**Note:**
This run must be in the document.

params.description: The comment text.
params.name: sText

params.description: The author's name.
params.name: sAuthor

params.description: The user ID of the comment author.
params.name: sUserId

returns.description: Returns null if the comment was not added.

AddComment.signature: AddComment(sText: string, sAuthor?: string, sUserId?: string): ApiComment | null

AddDrawing.description: Adds a drawing object (image, shape or chart) to the current text run.

params.description: The object which will be added to the current run.
params.name: oDrawing

returns.description: returns false if param is invalid.

AddHyperlink.description: Adds a hyperlink to the current run.

params.description: The link address.
params.name: link

params.description: The screen tip text.
params.name: screenTipText

params.description: name of a bookmark
params.name: bookmarkName

returns.description: returns false if params are invalid.

AddHyperlink.signature: AddHyperlink(link: string, screenTipText: string, bookmarkName: string): ApiHyperlink | null

AddLineBreak.description: Adds a line break to the current run position and starts the next element from a new line.

AddPageBreak.description: Adds a page break and starts the next element from a new page.

AddTabStop.description: Adds a tab stop to the current run.

AddText.description: Adds some text to the current run.

params.description: The text which will be added to the current run. It can be a string or an array of Unicode code points.
params.name: text

params.description: An array of character widths (in millimeters). It should be the same length as the array of code points passed in the "text" parameter. When the widths are specified, the characters are added preserving these exact widths.
params.name: widths

AddText.signature: AddText(text: string | number[], widths?: number[]): boolean

ClearContent.description: Clears the content from the current run.

Copy.description: Creates a copy of the current run.

GetBold.description: Gets the bold property from the current text properties.

GetCaps.description: Returns whether the text with the current text properties are capitalized.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiRun class.

GetColor.description: Gets the RGB color from the current text properties.

GetDoubleStrikeout.description: Gets the double strikeout property from the current text properties.

GetFontFamily.description:
Returns the font family from the current text properties.

The method automatically calculates the font from the theme if the font was set via the theme.

GetFontNames.description: Returns all font names from all elements inside the current run.

returns.description: The font names used for the current run.

GetFontSize.description: Gets the font size from the current text properties.

GetHighlight.description: Gets the highlight property from the current text properties.

GetItalic.description: Gets the italic property from the current text properties.

GetLanguage.description: Gets the language from the current text properties.

GetOutLine.description: Gets the text outline from the current text properties.

GetParent.description: Returns the parent element (a paragraph or an inline content control) that directly contains the current run.

returns.description: returns null if the run has no parent.

GetParentContentControl.description: Returns a content control that contains the current run.

returns.description: returns null if parent content control doesn't exist.

GetParentParagraph.description: Returns a parent paragraph of the current run.

GetParentTable.description: Returns a table that contains the current run.

returns.description: returns null if parent table doesn't exist.

GetParentTableCell.description: Returns a table cell that contains the current run.

returns.description: returns null is parent cell doesn't exist.

GetPosInParent.description: Returns the position (index) of the current run within its parent element.

returns.description: returns -1 if the run has no parent.

GetPosition.description: Gets the text position from the current text properties measured in half-points (1/144 of an inch).

GetRange.description:
Returns a Range object that represents the part of the document contained in the specified run.

The run must be attached to the document before calling this method.

params.description: Start position index in the current element.
params.name: Start

params.description: End position index in the current element.
params.name: End

GetShd.description: Gets the text shading from the current text properties.

GetSmallCaps.description: Returns whether the text with the current text properties are displayed capitalized two points smaller than the actual font size.

GetSpacing.description: Gets the text spacing from the current text properties measured in twentieths of a point.

GetStrikeout.description: Gets the strikeout property from the current text properties.

GetStyle.description: Gets the style of the current text properties.

GetText.description: Returns a text from the text run.

params.description: Options for formatting the returned text.
params.name: options

GetText.signature: GetText(options?: { NewLineSeparator?: string; TabSymbol?: string }): string

GetTextFill.description: Gets the text fill from the current text properties.

GetTextPr.description: Returns the text properties of the current run.

GetUnderline.description: Gets the underline property from the current text properties.

GetVertAlign.description: Gets the vertical alignment type from the current text properties.

MoveCursorToPos.description:
Moves a cursor to a specified position of the current text run.

If the current run is not assigned to any document part, then **false** is returned. Otherwise, this method returns **true**.
If there is any selection in the document, it will be removed.

params.description: Desired cursor position.
params.name: nPos

RemoveAllElements.description: Removes all the elements from the current run.

SetBold.description: Sets the bold property to the text character.

params.description: Specifies that the contents of the run are displayed bold.
params.name: isBold

SetCaps.description: Specifies that any lowercase characters in the text run are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents.

params.description: Specifies that the contents of the current run are displayed capitalized.
params.name: isCaps

SetColor.description: Sets the text color to the current text run.

params.description: The text color. Pass _null_ to remove the text color.
params.name: color

SetDoubleStrikeout.description: Specifies that the contents of the run are displayed with two horizontal lines through each character displayed on the line.

params.description: Specifies that the contents of the current run are displayed double struck through.
params.name: isDoubleStrikeout

SetFontFamily.description: Sets all 4 font slots with the specified font family.

params.description: The font family or families used for the current text run. Pass _null_ or omit it to remove the font family.
params.name: sFontFamily

SetFontSize.description: Sets the font size to the characters of the current text run.

params.description: The text size value measured in half-points (1/144 of an inch). Pass _null_ to remove the font size.
params.name: size

SetHighlight.description: Specifies a highlighting color which is added to the text properties and applied as a background to the contents of the current run/range/paragraph.

params.description: Available highlight color.
params.name: sColor

SetItalic.description: Sets the italic property to the text character.

params.description: Specifies that the contents of the current run are displayed italicized.
params.name: isItalic

SetLanguage.description:
Specifies the languages which will be used to check spelling and grammar (if requested) when processing
the contents of the text run.

params.description: The possible value for this parameter is a language identifier as defined byRFC 4646/BCP 47. Example: "en-CA". Pass _null_ to remove the language.
params.name: langId

SetOutLine.description: Sets the text outline to the current text run.

params.description: The stroke used to create the text outline.
params.name: oStroke

SetPosition.description:
Specifies an amount by which text is raised or lowered for this run in relation to the default
baseline of the surrounding non-positioned text.

params.description: Specifies a positive (raised text) or negative (lowered text)measurement in half-points (1/144 of an inch). Pass _null_ to remove the position.
params.name: position

SetShd.description: Specifies the shading applied to the contents of the current text run.

params.description: The shading created with the Api.CreateShd method.
params.name: shd

SetSmallCaps.description:
Specifies that all the small letter characters in the text run are formatted for display only as their capital
letter character equivalents which are two points smaller than the actual font size specified for this text.

params.description: Specifies if the contents of the current run are displayed capitalized two points smaller or not.
params.name: isSmallCaps

SetSpacing.description: Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.

params.description: The value of the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch). Pass _null_ to remove the text spacing.
params.name: spacing

SetStrikeout.description: Specifies that the contents of the run are displayed with a single horizontal line through the center of the line.

params.description: Specifies that the contents of the current run are displayed struck through.
params.name: isStrikeout

SetStyle.description:
The text style base method.

**Note:**
This method is not used by itself, as it only forms the basis for the {@link ApiRun#SetStyle} method which sets
the selected or created style to the text.

params.description: The style which must be applied to the text character, or the name of an existing style, or _undefined_/_null_ to remove the style.
params.name: style

SetText.description: Replaces the whole text of the current run with the specified text, keeping the run properties.

params.description: The new text of the run, as a string or as an array of character codes.
params.name: text

SetTextFill.description: Sets the text fill to the current text run.

params.description: The color or pattern used to fill the text color.
params.name: oApiFill

SetTextPr.description: Sets the text properties to the current run.

params.description: The text properties that will be set to the current run.
params.name: oTextPr

SetUnderline.description:
Specifies that the contents of the run are displayed along with a line appearing directly below the character
(less than all the spacing above and below the characters on the line).

params.description: Specifies that the contents of the current run are displayed underlined.
params.name: isUnderline

SetVertAlign.description:
Specifies the alignment which will be applied to the contents of the run in relation to the default appearance of the run text:

- **"baseline"** - the characters in the current text run will be aligned by the default text baseline.
- **"subscript"** - the characters in the current text run will be aligned below the default text baseline.
- **"superscript"** - the characters in the current text run will be aligned above the default text baseline.

params.description: The vertical alignment type applied to the text contents. Pass _null_ to remove the vertical alignment.
params.name: type

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiRun object into the JSON object.

params.description: Specifies if the used styles will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: bWriteStyles

WrapInMailMergeField.description: Wraps a run in a mail merge field.
